confirmed: The product name is 人生试运行. It does not reuse the 潮生 or Lifetide product name.

decisions.title: Name the product 人生试运行
decisions.decision: The standalone lightweight product is named 人生试运行. The prior working name 潮生｜人生试玩 is retired.
decisions.rationale: 人生试运行 states the product mechanism directly, feels lighter and more contemporary than 人生模拟器, and connects naturally to three alternative lives and the three-day reversible trial.
